purge.title: Delete this product from the database?
purge.description: This is a permanent, irreversible delete. The product, its variants, its stock, its images and its presence on the storefront and POS are all removed, its lines are taken out of every purchase invoice, and each of those invoices is recalculated. Sales invoices stay exactly as they are, under the product name already stored on the line.

purge.blockedTitle: Blocked: unclassified tables still reference this product
purge.purchasesHint: The header tax and discount are left alone — the total is recomputed from the remaining lines, exactly as it is when you edit the invoice by hand. What was paid to the supplier does not change.
purge.tablesTitle: Tables rows will be deleted from
purge.salesKeptHint: {{total}} sales invoice line(s) stay in place under their stored name and SKU, losing only the pointer to the product — so historic revenue and profit do not move.
purge.done: Product permanently removed from the database.
purge.doneWithPurchases: Product permanently removed. {{total}} purchase invoice(s) updated.
